import sys, time
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options

def make_driver():
    opts = Options()
    opts.add_argument("--headless=new")
    opts.add_argument("--no-sandbox")
    opts.add_argument("--disable-dev-shm-usage")
    opts.add_argument("--disable-gpu")
    return webdriver.Chrome(options=opts)

def check(path):
    d = make_driver()
    try:
        d.execute_cdp_cmd("Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument", {
            "source": "window.__alerts=[]; window.alert=function(m){window.__alerts.push(String(m));};"
        })
        d.get("file://" + path)
        time.sleep(2)
        try:
            alerts = d.execute_script("return window.__alerts;")
        except Exception as e:
            alerts = ["ERR:"+str(e)]
        pending = None
        try:
            a = d.switch_to.alert
            pending = a.text
            a.dismiss()
        except Exception:
            pending = None
        return alerts, pending
    finally:
        d.quit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    alerts, pending = check(sys.argv[1])
    print("alerts captured:", alerts)
    print("pending alert:", pending
